Markets.title: Nifty mega caps are going nowhere. Why Samco CIO Umesh Mehta put 75% of his Flexicap fund beyond largecaps
Markets.summary: Samco CIO Umesh Mehta has allocated 75% of his Flexicap fund to mid- and small-cap stocks because Nifty mega caps are constrained by high institutional ownership and slowing earnings momentum. He sees strong investment opportunities in defence, power, AI ancillaries, and gold, while warning of potential market liquidity pressures caused by heavy IPO activity.

Markets.title: MSCI rebalancing on Monday: Adani Energy, Groww set for big inflows; RIL, Jio Financial may face outflows
Markets.summary: MSCI's index rebalancing on Monday will cause significant trading activity as revised weights take effect. Adani Energy and Groww are expected to receive large inflows, while Reliance Industries and Jio Financial may experience outflows.

Markets.title: Quality Stock Investing: 8 mistakes that can ruin your portfolio and how to avoid them
Markets.summary: Lawrence A. Cunningham's quality-investing framework identifies eight critical errors that can ruin an investment portfolio. Avoiding mistakes like ignoring debt, overrelying on macroeconomic trends, and holding stocks with deteriorating fundamentals helps investors successfully build portfolios of high-quality companies.

Markets.title: Warren Buffett turns 96: Top 10 investing lessons from the Oracle of Omaha
Markets.summary: As Warren Buffett celebrates his 96th birthday following his departure as Berkshire Hathaway's CEO, an article highlights the core investment strategies behind his six-decade career. These guiding principles include maintaining patience and discipline, investing only within his circle of competence, and concentrating capital on high-conviction ideas.

Markets.title: SBI, SBI Capital Markets plan 1% NSE stake sale via IPO: Bank Chairman C S Setty
Markets.summary: State Bank of India and SBI Capital Markets plan to sell nearly one percent of their National Stock Exchange stake through the exchange's upcoming IPO. Additionally, SBI's mortgage portfolio is projected to surpass ten lakh crore rupees this quarter.

Markets.title: Nifty weekly outlook: Nifty trapped in 23,900-24,750 range; fresh buying should remain selective
Markets.summary: The Nifty index remained trapped in a narrow range between 23,900 and 24,750 as moving averages continued to cap its upside. Market volatility declined while immediate support held steady between the 23,900 and 24,000 levels.

Geo-Political.title: Footage of Tibet floods isn't being shown in China - and we know little about victims there
Geo-Political.summary: Dramatic footage of deadly flash floods in Tibet is being hidden from the public inside China. Consequently, very little information is currently known about the victims in the region.

Geo-Political.title: Manhunt after shooting at Swiss rave kills woman, 22, and injures five
Geo-Political.summary: A shooting at a rave in Aarau, near Zurich, killed a 22-year-old woman and injured five others in their twenties. Police have launched a manhunt for the suspect following the overnight attack.

Geo-Political.title: At least 37 dead and hundreds evacuated after strike on Kyiv weapons depot
Geo-Political.summary: At least 37 people were killed and hundreds evacuated following a strike on a weapons depot near a residential area in Kyiv. Authorities have launched an investigation into the military storage site's location.

Geo-Political.title: Iceland on track to reject EU referendum as counting nears end
Geo-Political.summary: Icelandic broadcaster RUV reports that the nation is on track to reject resuming membership talks with the European Union. Final votes are currently being tallied to confirm the outcome of the referendum.

Geo-Political.title: WhatsApp chat used to send cash for crime and extremism
Geo-Political.summary: Criminals and extremists used WhatsApp to arrange cash transfers across the UK and globally. These transactions left no paper trail, allowing the network to launder money securely.

Geo-Political.title: Large Lake Ontario sign installed in Canada in latest jab at US
Geo-Political.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford unveiled a billboard on the Canadian shoreline bearing the message "Lake Ontario. Now and Always." The sign represents the latest geopolitical jab directed at the United States.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

Data & Insights.title: PM Modi in Tashkent: India, Uzbekistan seek to unlock next phase of $1.5 billion trade ties
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Tashkent to discuss expanding economic relations between India and Uzbekistan. Both nations currently share $1.5 billion in bilateral trade and aim to double this figure to $3 billion within the next three years.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council sets date for first meeting since rationalisation last year
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council will hold its 57th meeting on September 12 in New Delhi. This marks the council's first meeting since last year's tax rationalisation.

Data & Insights.title: India to start preparations for Budget 2027 from 12 October
Data & Insights.summary: India will begin pre-budget consultations for the 2027 fiscal year on October 12. Finance Secretary (Expenditure) V. Vualnam will chair these upcoming preparation meetings.

Data & Insights.title: India forex reserves hit record high on RBI steps to attract US dollars
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves reached a record high due to Reserve Bank of India measures aimed at attracting US dollars. This increase provides the central bank with greater ability to support the rupee, which remains one of Asia's worst-performing currencies.

Data & Insights.title: Industrial output growth narrows to 6.7% in July from 8.8% in June
Data & Insights.summary: India's industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in July from 8.8% in June due to a dip in mining. However, overall growth remained strong, driven by the manufacturing and capital goods sectors.

Data & Insights.title: Algeria becomes India's 3rd-largest source of LPG in August amid supply crunch
Data & Insights.summary: In August, Algeria supplied 110,711 tonnes of liquefied petroleum gas to India, accounting for about a tenth of the country's total imports. This volume made Algeria India's third-largest source of LPG during a period of tight global supply.

India.title: Himanta Biswa Sarma Speaks To 8 Assam Residents Rescued In Nepal
India.summary: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma spoke with eight residents from his state who were rescued from Nepal. Meanwhile, the death toll from flash floods in Nepal increased to 734 as rescue operations continued.

India.title: New Sport Alert: IIT Madras Launches Phiball, Fast-Paced 3-Team Invasion Game
India.summary: IIT Madras has launched a new fast-paced, three-team invasion sport called Phiball. During the match, teams change the basket they defend after every quarter to create shifting offensive and defensive situations.

India.title: YouTuber Falsely Portrays Teacher As Mumbai Mayor's Husband, Case Filed
India.summary: Police filed a case against a YouTuber for publishing a video that falsely claimed a teacher was the Mumbai Mayor's husband. The FIR states the video included the teacher's personal details, family background, and misleading visuals.

India.title: Suspicious Of Lover's Infidelity, Mumbai Man Kills Her With Poisoned Soft Drink
India.summary: A pregnant Mumbai woman named Vishnumaya was killed by her boyfriend. He poisoned her soft drink because he suspected she was unfaithful.

India.title: Speeding Fortuner Kills 3 Siblings In Faridabad. They Had Met For Rakhi
India.summary: A speeding Toyota Fortuner in Faridabad struck and killed three siblings who had gathered to celebrate Raksha Bandhan. The fourth sibling survived the crash, which occurred just hours after their joyous reunion.

India.title: Mohan Bhagwat Recalls World's Worst Mid-Air Collision: What Happened In 1996
India.summary: In 1996, two passenger planes collided mid-air over Charkhi Dadri in India. The disaster resulted in the deaths of all 349 people on board both aircraft.

General.title: PC Harper's killers to stay in jail as PM announces changes to early release scheme
General.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham announced that anyone convicted of manslaughter will be excluded from the early release scheme in the Sentencing Act. As a result, the killers of PC Harper will remain in jail.

General.title: Burnham gets the early prison release changes he wanted - but at what cost?
General.summary: The prime minister says he will keep hundreds more criminals behind bars but doing so requires complex changes.

General.title: Man killed by falling sign at Christian festival named by church as pastor Robert Guanco
General.summary: Robert Guanco, 41, was a pastor at Jesus the Living Water Church in Eastbourne, East Sussex.

General.title: Search continues for boat 'in distress' in Channel as two people still missing
General.summary: The coastguard is searching the English Channel for a distressed boat carrying five crew members. Two of the crew remain missing while the search continues.

General.summary: Criminals used a WhatsApp group chat to arrange cash transfers worth millions of pounds without leaving a paper trail. These funds were then used to finance crimes and extremist activities in the UK and globally.
